```{r}
# 2024 corrected buoy data
```

```{r}
b22 <- b22 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct()

bsal2 <- bsal %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime)) %>% 
  filter(WaterSalinity_UQL == 2 & year == 2022) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(mean_sal = mean(WaterSalinity)) %>% 
  ungroup()

f22 <- f %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  filter(year == 2022)

wind <- wind %>% 
  mutate(date = mdy(date))

wind22 <- wind %>% 
  filter(year == 2022)
  
```

```{r}
cd <- cd %>% 
  filter(filter_type == "Bulk GF/F" & line_out_depth == 0) %>% 
  select(date, chla)
```

```{r}
b22 <- b22 %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr),
         year = lubridate::year(date),
         yday = lubridate::yday(date)) 

b22 <- b22 %>% 
  left_join(cd) %>% 
  left_join(bsal2)
```
```{r}
#Working with chemtax data to make it easy to plot

#Making the date column a date format
chem <- chem %>% 
  mutate(date2 = lubridate::mdy(Date)) 

#Selecting appropriate columns and renaming to easy to work with names
chem <- chem %>%
  select(date = date2, cyan = Cyanobacteria, hapt = Hapto, 
         GA = `Prasinophytes-3`, cryp = Cryptophytes,
         dino = `Dinoflagellates-1`, raph = Raphido,
         dict = Dictyo, diat = `Diatoms-1`)

#Pivoting to long/tidy for plotting in ggplot
chem <- chem %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(cyan:diat), names_to = "group", values_to = "contribution")

#Calculating TChla for each sample
chem_tchla <- chem %>% 
  group_by(date, group) %>% 
  summarise(contribution = mean(contribution)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  mutate(tchla = sum(contribution)) %>% 
  ungroup()


#checking to see if there are any duplicates - there were replicates taken for DFO comparisons. None found because I already averaged these for the manuscript.
chem_dup <- chem_tchla %>%
  distinct(date, tchla) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  mutate(dup = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(dup > 1)

#Good to move forward
```

```{r}
b22_long <- b22 %>%
  select(date_corr, chla, fl_med_day, mean_sal) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(chla, fl_med_day, mean_sal),
              names_to = "par", values_to = "val") %>% 
  mutate(date = date(date_corr))
```

```{r}
# f3 <- 
  
f2 <-   b22_long %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = val, color = par)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = date("2024-03-05"), xmax = date("2024-04-30"),
           ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = 'darkgreen', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(b22_long,
                          par == "fl_med_day"),
            size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(b22_long,
                          par == "mean_sal"),
            size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(b22_long,
                          par == "chla"),
            size = 4, pch = 8, stroke = 2) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
  #            linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "black") +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-04-06"),
  #            linetype = "dashed", size = 1, color = "black") +
  # annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-15"), y = 21,
  #          label = "b)",
  #          size = 10) +
  ggsci::scale_color_jama(labels = c(expression(Chl[Discrete]),
                                         expression(Chl[BUOY]),
                                         expression(Salinity[BUOY]))) +
  scale_x_date(limits = as_date(c("2022-01-01", "2022-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  ylab(expression(atop(Chl~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")",
                       paste("Salinity")))) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  
  # labs(y = bquote(Buoy[FLU]~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")"),
  #      x  = NULL,
  #      color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        text = element_text(size = 35), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())
```








```{r}
#Now plot 2024 CTD profiles
# f2 <- 
  
# f4 <- 
  
# f3 <-  
# https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/palr/vignettes/nasa_chla.html
# maxrange <- c(0.01, 10)
# pal <- chl_pal(palette = TRUE)  
# sb <- which(pal$breaks >= maxrange[1] & pal$breaks <= maxrange[2])
  
f3 <- f22 %>% 
  filter(pres < 51) %>% 
  mutate(day = 15,
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date)) %>% 
  unite(date_2, c(year, month, day), sep = "-", remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(date_2 = date(date_2)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_tile(aes(y = pres, fill = f_npq)) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
  #            linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "white") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5,
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1, color = "white") +
  # annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-15"), y = 5,
  #          label = "c)",
  #          size = 10) +
  # annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-11-19"), y = 9,
  #          label = "5m",
  #          size = 10,
  #          color = "white") +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10)) +
  # cmocean::scale_fill_cmocean(name = "delta",
  #                             limits = c(0, 20),
  #                             oob = scales::squish) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 30),
                       oob = scales::squish) +
  labs(fill = bquote(CTD[FLU]~"(mg" ~ m^-3*")"),
       y = "Depth") +
  scale_x_date(limits = as_date(c("2022-01-01", "2022-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 38), #35
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.height = unit(1.8, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30, angle = 270),
        legend.title.align = 0.5,
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        axis.text.x = element_blank()
        ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "right"))

  # theme(text = element_text(size = 35), #35
  #       axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
  #       axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  #       legend.position = "top",
  #       legend.box = "horizontal") +
  # guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
  #                               barwidth = 50, barheight = 1,
  #                               frame.colour = "black", ticks.colour = "black"))
```


```{r}

#Setting plotting order phytoplankton groups

#Order phytoplankton groups roughly from smallest to largest - create order list
order_chem <- c("cyan", "hapt", "GA", "cryp",
                   "dino", "raph", "dict", "diat")

#Chemtax full data - Specify order of phyto groups for figures
chem_tchla <- arrange(mutate(chem_tchla,
                                group = factor(group,
                                levels = order_chem)))


```

```{r}
# f5 <- 
  
f4 <- chem_tchla %>%
  ggplot() +
  # annotate("rect", xmin = date("2024-03-05"), xmax = date("2024-04-30"),
  #          ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = 'darkgreen', alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_bar(aes(date, contribution, fill = fct_rev(group)),
           position = "stack", stat = "identity",
           alpha = 1, color = "black", size = 1) +
  # geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2024-03-18"),
  #            linetype = "solid", size = 1, color = "black") +
  # annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-01-15"), y = 5.4,
  #          label = "d)",
  #          size = 10) +
  # annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-12-15"), y = 5.4,
  #          label = "5m",
  #          size = 10) +
  ggsci::scale_fill_npg() +
  # lims(y = c(0, 5)) +
  scale_x_date(limits = as.Date(c("2022-01-01", "2022-12-31")),
               expand = c(0, 0),
               date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = bquote("Phyto. (mg" ~ m^-3*")"),
       fill = "Group") +
  theme(
        legend.position = "right",
```
